name: 9x19mm Standard
description:
The 9x19mm Standard is the most widely produced handgun cartridge in GLMZ 2200 and has been the dominant semi-automatic pistol round on Earth for the better part of three centuries. Its survival into the twenty-third century is not a matter of sentiment — it is a matter of physics, logistics, and the brutal economics of a megacity that runs on standardized consumables. The round feeds reliably in an almost incomprehensible variety of platforms, from Arcturus Civil Security's duty pistols to the cobbled-together street hardware carried by Excluded zone survivors to the high-spec augmented-grip sidearms favored by corporate security details. In GLMZ, saying you carry a nine is like saying you breathe recycled air. It is not a statement. It is a baseline.

By 2200, the 9x19mm Standard has diverged significantly from its twentieth-century ancestor in projectile technology while remaining dimensionally compatible with legacy chambers. Modern production loads are available in fragmenting, armor-defeating, subdermal-defeating, and subsonic configurations, and caseless 9x19mm has become the standard for military and higher-tier security applications while brass-cased remains dominant in the civilian and gray markets. The Kang-Petrov KP-19 'Workhorse' — the round's most iconic GLMZ platform — is chambered for the standard spec, and the round's association with that weapon has given it a streetwise credibility that more exotic calibers can't quite replicate. When Kyle Corbin-Vasik's KP-19 clears leather, it's nine-mil that does the talking.
compatibility_note: Compatible with the vast majority of semi-automatic pistols and select-fire personal defense weapons in GLMZ including the Kang-Petrov KP-19 'Workhorse', Arcturus-issue duty pistols, and hundreds of legacy and current-production platforms. Both brass-cased and caseless variants available; caseless requires modern chamber spec. Submachine gun and PDW compatibility is extensive.
reliability_note: The gold standard for reliability in handgun ammunition. Decades of optimized manufacturing mean consistent ignition, consistent cycling, and predictable terminal performance. Functions across the full range of GLMZ environmental conditions from climate-controlled arcology interiors to the unregulated exterior zones. No energy dependency. Brass-cased is the most reliable configuration; caseless is reliable in platforms designed for it.
